stage: C3X 0.8.0-G10-P12 — Prospective Nonconjugacy Obstruction-Basis Reconstruction, Edge-Minimal Search-Topology Defect Certificates, Engine-Pair Conditional Transition Residuals, Board-Edit Obstruction Localization, Source-Stable Defect Recurrence, Shared-Core+Sparse-Defect Factorization, Counterfactual Defect Removal & Search-Topology Difference Experiment

inherited_facts: No engine pair is exactly conjugate under semantic relabeling.
No engine pair is exactly conjugate even under full S4.
The pooled parity quotient is source-fragile and fiber-inconsistent.
The surviving object is engine-pair-specific nonconjugacy obstruction geometry.

explanandum: Can each engine-pair nonconjugacy obstruction be represented as a small, source-recurrent basis of signed edit×edge defects on top of a shared transition-support core, rather than as unstructured global difference?

alignment_freeze.rule: Use the P11 pooled best semantic map for each engine pair; no map may be reselected using P12 sparsity or recurrence.

residual_tensor.shared_core: Support-edge intersection after frozen P11 semantic alignment.
residual_tensor.residual: Signed symmetric difference after frozen P11 semantic alignment.

primary_basis.name: SIGNED_BOOLEAN_RECTANGLE_DEFECT_BASIS
primary_basis.construction: For each engine pair and sign separately, form a 3×16 binary residual matrix with rows TARGET/SUBSET/SHAM and columns directed edges. Enumerate all maximal all-1 rectangles indexed by a nonempty edit subset and its compatible edge set. Find the exact minimum-cardinality rectangle cover of every residual 1-cell.
primary_basis.why_nontrivial: A rectangle generator may explain several edit×edge residual atoms jointly. Atomic one-cell toggles are retained only as the trivial upper bound.
outputs: essential generators present in every minimum cover

source_stability.stable_atom: Same signed edit×edge residual occurs in both sources under the frozen alignment.
source_stability.stable_generator: Every atom covered by the pooled generator is stable in both sources.
source_recurrence_metrics: stable residual atom count / pooled residual atom count
source_stability.authority_rule: A sparse pooled basis with poor source recurrence cannot support a stable defect-family claim.

counterfactual_removal.full_basis_check: Applying all generators of any minimum exact cover must remove every pooled support obstruction by construction; this is an implementation validity check, not scientific evidence.
counterfactual_removal.stable_only_test: Apply only source-stable pooled generators to source-specific residual matrices. Measure remaining obstruction mass.
counterfactual_removal.leave_one_generator_out: For each essential pooled generator, omit it and report residual obstruction mass; this tests generator necessity inside the frozen grammar.

cross_pair_structure.claim_ceiling: Cross-pair recurrence is descriptive unless the same generator is source-stable in each participating pair.

sparsity_interpretation.strong_candidate: Minimum basis is substantially smaller than atomic residual count AND a nontrivial fraction of essential generators is source-stable.
sparsity_interpretation.weak_candidate: Pooled compression exists but source-stable coverage is low.
sparsity_interpretation.failure: Minimum basis is near-atomic or source recurrence collapses.

claim_ceiling: No causal engine-internals claim from support residuals alone.
No objective chess truth or human utility claim.
